description: Sent by Afifa via FMOS button on the day of a scheduled follow-back call. Two separate templates — one for leads who heard the pitch (INTERESTED_FOLLOW_UP_LATER), one for leads who just said busy before hearing anything (FOLLOW_BACK). Both include the landing page link but with different messaging.

templates.label: Follow-Back Reminder — Heard Pitch (INTERESTED_FOLLOW_UP_LATER)
templates.note: Lead heard the pitch and showed interest. They know what FortuneMarq is. Message continues from where the conversation left off.
templates.message:
Hi {{businessName}}! 👋

Just a heads up — I'm calling you today around {{callTime}} as we discussed.

Have a look at the link before the call if you haven't yet: {{landingPageLink}}

Talk soon!
— Afifa, FortuneMarq

templates.label: Follow-Back Reminder — Said Busy Before Pitch (FOLLOW_BACK)
templates.note: Lead barely heard the intro and said busy. They don't know what FortuneMarq is yet. Message reintroduces FortuneMarq and teases the market research.
templates.message:
Hi {{businessName}}! 👋

This is Afifa from FortuneMarq — we spoke briefly earlier. I'm calling back today around {{callTime}}.

We have some interesting market research for {{niche}} businesses in {{city}} to share with you. Have a quick look before the call: {{landingPageLink}}

Talk soon!
— Afifa, FortuneMarq
